definitions: Under the surface of a liquid; sunk.
simple past and past participle of immerse

blocks.text: Immersion is a 2021 thriller film directed by Nicolás Postiglione and starring Alfredo Castro. An international co-production between Chile and Mexico, the film is about a family sailing trip that takes an unexpected turn. The film had its world premiere at the 2021 Guadalajara International Film Festival, where it won a number of awards.

Takashi Shimizu is a Japanese filmmaker. He is best known for being the creator of the Ju-On franchise, directing the first four installments, in addition to directing the first two installments in its American remake franchise, The Grudge.
